policies.title: Armenian ordinary passports: Marshall Islands advance visitor visa
policies.summary: The Marshall Islands Embassy requires countries outside its named exemptions and diplomatic-relations cohort to obtain a visa before travel. Armenia's current Foreign Ministry record expressly says bilateral diplomatic relations have not been established.
conditions: Applies to a current ordinary Armenian passport for short visitor travel. Armenia is not in the Embassy's named A exemption cohort, and Armenia's Foreign Ministry expressly establishes that it is outside the diplomatic-relations B cohort.

The advance visitor-visa rule does not promise approval or admission and does not cover residence, work, business licensing, diplomatic or official passports, crew, visiting forces, international-organization exemptions or other special categories.
